subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Departure: Date & Time Arrival: Date & Time Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. Should you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
